# Grid column resize ignores flex columns and leaves GroupRow unprojected during live drag

## Context

During the Engine 13.4 release-gate verification matrix on `#20379` (*Grid columns can sit under a shared group header*, evaluated on `dev` at `ccb30d8d6e`), real-pointer Playwright + Neural Link testing of column resizing (`Row 6`) on `examples/grid/headerGroups` surfaced two defects in `Neo.grid.header.plugin.Resizable` and `Neo.grid.Body#updateCellPositions`.

## The Problem

Measured in Chromium on `examples/grid/headerGroups` (`dev` at `ccb30d8d6e`):

1. **Row 6A — Resizing a `flex` leaf column (`Dec`, `{flex: 1, minWidth: 150}`) is a complete no-op:**
   - In `examples/grid/headerGroups/MainContainer.mjs:8`, `Dec` is configured with `{flex: 1, minWidth: 150}` (and `resizable: true` by default). At viewport `2600×800`, `Dec` flexes to `528px`.
   - Dragging `Dec`'s `.neo-resizable-right` handle by `-150px` leaves `Dec`'s width completely unchanged (`ROW_6_RESIZE_DETAILS: {"decWidthBefore":528,"decWidthAfter":528}`).
2. **Row 6B — Group header cells stay frozen during live column resize (`onDragMove`) and only snap to their leaves on `mouseup` (`onDragEnd`):**
   - While dragging `Feb`'s `.neo-resizable-right` handle by `+80px` (prior to `mouseup`), `Feb`'s header button and body cells widen live on every pointer step (`leafRight: 705`), while `Q1`'s `.neo-grid-header-group-cell` remains frozen at `right: 631` (`q1DuringFebResize: {"text":"Q1","left":181,"right":631,"leafLeft":181,"leafRight":705}` — a **`74px` misalignment mid-drag**), snapping to `right: 705` only after `mouseup` calls `toolbar.passSizeToBody()` (`q1AfterFebResize: {"text":"Q1","left":181,"right":705,"leafLeft":181,"leafRight":705}`).

## The Architectural Reality

- **Why resizing a `flex` column is a no-op (`src/grid/header/plugin/Resizable.mjs:81-84, 116-119` + `src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs:365-369`):**
  - `Resizable#onDragMove` (`lines 81-84`) and `onDragEnd` (`lines 116-118`) write `owner.width = newWidth` and `owner.wrapperStyle = {width: `${newWidth}px`}`, **but never set `owner.flex = 'none'`**.
  - On `Neo.grid.header.Button`, `flex` defaults to `'none'`. When a column is configured with `flex: 1`, `button.flex` is `1`, which emits `style.flex = '1 1 0%'` on the button wrapper. In a flex toolbar (`display: flex`), `flex: 1 1 0%` overrides `style.width` whenever free space exists in the container, and `Toolbar#isMeasuredWidth(item)` (`src/grid/header/Toolbar.mjs:368`: `return !!((flex && flex !== 'none') || ...)`) continues to treat the column as flex-sized on subsequent layout passes.
  - Once a user explicitly resizes a `flex` column via its resize handle, the column's width is user-pinned in pixels and `owner.flex` must be cleared to `'none'`.
- **Why `GroupRow` lags behind live column resize (`src/grid/header/plugin/Resizable.mjs:86-88` + `src/grid/Body.mjs:1595-1653`):**
  - During `Resizable#onDragMove`, `body.updateCellPositions(owner.dataField, newWidth)` (`src/grid/Body.mjs:1595-1653`) updates `pos.width` for the resized column, shifts `pos.x += deltaWidth` for all following columns in `body.columnPositions`, updates `body.availableWidth`, and updates the active body rows' VDOM.
  - Because `GroupRow#project()` (`src/grid/header/GroupRow.mjs:68-121`) reads directly from `toolbar.body.columnPositions` and `toolbar.body.availableWidth` without any DOM measurement, calling `me.gridContainer?.headerWrapper?.groupRow?.project()` at the end of `Body#updateCellPositions` (or from `Resizable#onDragMove`) re-projects the group header cells in the exact same frame as the body cells and leaf header button.

Design authority: `#20379` Fix step 3 (*"A group cell's left edge and width come from its first and last leaf's `columnPositions` entries, so a leaf resize, a flex re-layout or a reorder re-projects the row without a second measurement"*) + 13.4 release-gate verification matrix (Row 6).

## The Fix

1. **Clear `flex: 'none'` when resizing a header button (`src/grid/header/plugin/Resizable.mjs:81-84, 116-119`):**
   - Include `flex: 'none'` in `owner.set({flex: 'none', width: newWidth, wrapperStyle: {width: `${newWidth}px`}})` in `Resizable#onDragMove` (and ensure `owner.flex = 'none'` and the Corresponding `column.width = newWidth; column.flex = 'none'` stay in sync on `onDragEnd`), so user-resized `flex` columns adopt their dragged pixel width and `Toolbar#isMeasuredWidth` treats them as explicit-px columns thereafter.
2. **Re-project `GroupRow` during live resize (`src/grid/Body.mjs:1595-1653`):**
   - At the end of `Body#updateCellPositions`, invoke `me.gridContainer?.headerWrapper?.groupRow?.project()` so `.neo-grid-header-group-cell` edges track the leaf header and body cells live during `drag:move`, not only on `mouseup`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Resizable#onDragMove` / `onDragEnd` (`src/grid/header/plugin/Resizable.mjs:81-120`) | `#20379` AC-2 + Matrix Row 6A | Dragging the resize handle on a `flex` column (`Dec`) clears `flex: 'none'` and resizes the column to `newWidth` (clamped by `minWidth` / `maxWidth`) | Fixed-width columns (`flex: 'none'`) behave identically to today | JSDoc on `onDragMove` / `onDragEnd` | E2E in `HeaderGroups.spec.mjs` (resizing `Dec` changes its width and re-projects `Q4`) |
| `Resizable#onDragMove` (`src/grid/header/plugin/Resizable.mjs:81-94`) | `#20379` Fix step 3 + Matrix Row 6B | Calls `owner.parent.gridContainer.headerWrapper?.groupRow?.project()` right after `body.updateCellPositions(owner.dataField, newWidth)`, keeping group cells aligned mid-drag as a header-side concern | Grids without `groupRow` (`groupRow === null`) no-op via optional chaining | JSDoc on `onDragMove` | E2E in `HeaderGroups.spec.mjs` asserting `groupEdges` alignment mid-drag before `mouseup` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1 (Row 6A — Resizing a `flex` leaf column):** Dragging `Dec`'s resize handle at wide viewport (`2600×800`, where `Dec` flexes > `300px`) resizes `Dec` to the dragged pixel width, clears `flex: 'none'`, and updates `Q4`'s right edge to match `Dec`'s right edge (e2e).
- [ ] **AC-2 (Row 6B — Live mid-drag `GroupRow` projection):** During a column resize drag on `Feb` (before `page.mouse.up()`), `Q1`'s `.neo-grid-header-group-cell` right edge matches `Mar`'s right edge (`< 2px`) and `Q2..Q4` shift live in lockstep (e2e).

## Out of Scope

- Header drag-and-drop reorder (`SortZone` / `GroupRow`, tracked in sibling ticket under `#20379`).
- Emptying locked regions and runtime `column.locked` group splitting (`Wrapper` / `Container`, tracked in sibling ticket under `#20379`).

## Avoided Traps

- **Only asserting `groupEdges` after `page.mouse.up()` (`HeaderGroups.spec.mjs:93-99`):** `onDragEnd` calls `toolbar.passSizeToBody()`, which re-projects `GroupRow` on drop and hides the fact that `GroupRow` stayed frozen throughout `onDragMove`.
